data.action: 趴在课桌上侧头浅睡，嘴边衔着棒棒糖，鲨鱼尾巴垂在桌边地毯上轻轻晃动
data.camera: medium close-up, eye-level, shallow depth of field
data.description: 【艾莲·乔 · 慵懒午后的靠窗打盹】新艾利都高中女子部的暖洋洋午后，微风吹拂窗帘。艾莲趴在靠窗的课桌上酣睡，黑红挑染的短发散乱在臂弯间，嘴里还衔着未吃完的棒棒糖小棒。那根引人注目的巨大厚重鲨鱼尾巴从课桌侧面垂落，尖端在木质地板上无意识地轻轻拍打，透着令人安心的慵懒少女气息。
data.lighting: 窗帘缝隙透入的温暖金色斜阳与柔和漫反射
data.promptProse: Ellen sleeps at the window desk in her white sailor shirt and navy skirt, black-and-red hair spread across her folded arms and an unfinished lollipop stick still at her lips. Her heavy shark tail hangs beside the desk and taps the wooden floor. The eye-level medium close-up includes the curtain behind. Golden afternoon light enters through its gap onto her hair and cuff, with gentle reflected brightness in the shaded tabletop.
data.title: 艾莲·乔 · 慵懒午后的靠窗打盹
